stages.query: SELECT f.__path,(f.__start*16777216+f.__end) AS id,f.__start,f.__end,f.name,f.rt,coalesce((SELECT group_concat(k.name,'.') FROM (SELECT k.name FROM classes k WHERE k.__path=f.__path AND k.__start<f.__start AND k.__end>=f.__end ORDER BY k.__start) k),'') AS class_name,rx_matches(f.name,'_lazy$') OR f.name IN ('compile','lower','post_op','pre_op','preprocess') OR f.name='pending_pipeline_effects' OR rx_matches(f.name,'^apply_.*_effect$') OR f.dec IS NOT NULL AS planning,f.name='preprocess' AS preprocess,substr(f.name,-11)='sql_builder' AND f.name NOT IN ('compile','lower','post_op','pre_op','preprocess') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM b_params p WHERE p.__path=f.__path AND p.fn=(f.__start*16777216+f.__end) AND rx_matches(coalesce(p.ann,''),'\bCompilationContext\b')) AS ctx_helper,f.__path='impl/common/l2070_server_plan/backend_profiles.py' AND rx_matches(f.name,'component|components|score|scores') AS provider_helper,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM b_params p WHERE p.__path=f.__path AND p.fn=(f.__start*16777216+f.__end) AND p.name='runtime_refs') AND (rx_matches(f.name,'^materialize_.*builder$') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM b_params p WHERE p.__path=f.__path AND p.fn=(f.__start*16777216+f.__end) AND rx_matches(coalesce(p.ann,''),'\bRuntimeBuilderSpec\b'))) AS materializer FROM fns f WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fns o WHERE o.__path=f.__path AND o.__start<f.__start AND o.__end>=f.__end)

stages.name: splats
stages.query: SELECT __path,__start,__end,(c_start*16777216+c_end) AS call FROM (SELECT __path,__start,__end,r7_c_start AS c_start,r7_c_end AS c_end,r7_top_start AS top_start,r7_top_end AS top_end FROM nodes_in WHERE r7_role IS NOT NULL) UNION ALL SELECT __path,__start,__end,(c_start*16777216+c_end) FROM (SELECT __path,__start,__end,r8_c_start AS c_start,r8_c_end AS c_end,r8_top_start AS top_start,r8_top_end AS top_end FROM nodes_in WHERE r8_role IS NOT NULL)

stages.name: callback_parameters
stages.query: SELECT DISTINCT c.__path,c.id AS fn,p.name,k.name AS callback_kind,p.position FROM contexts c JOIN b_calls call ON call.__path=c.__path AND call.fn=c.id AND call.callee='CompiledStep' JOIN b_kws k ON k.__path=call.__path AND k.call=call.id AND k.name IN ('post_op','post_op_with_refs') AND k.v_kind='identifier' JOIN fns nested ON nested.__path=c.__path AND nested.name=k.vtext AND nested.__start>c.__start AND nested.__end<=c.__end JOIN b_params p ON p.__path=nested.__path AND p.fn=(nested.__start*16777216+nested.__end) WHERE p.position IN (1,2)

stages.name: parameter_kinds
stages.query: SELECT p.__path,p.fn,p.name,'authority' AS kind FROM b_params p WHERE p.name IN ('txn','read_txn','write_txn','conn','connection','sql_conn') OR rx_matches(coalesce(p.ann,''),'\b(?:ReadTransaction|SyncDatabaseConnection|SyncSqlConnection|WriteTransaction)\b') UNION SELECT p.__path,p.fn,p.name,'provider' FROM b_params p WHERE rx_matches(coalesce(p.ann,''),'\b(?:CrossBranchQueryProvider|HybridSearchProvider|VectorCandidateProvider|VersionedLoweringProvider|VersionedStorageProvider)\b') UNION SELECT p.__path,p.fn,p.name,'runtime_value' FROM b_params p LEFT JOIN contexts c ON c.__path=p.__path AND c.id=p.fn WHERE p.name='resolved' OR rx_matches(coalesce(p.ann,''),'\bResolvedRefs\b') OR c.materializer AND p.name='runtime_refs' UNION SELECT p.__path,p.fn,p.name,'carrier' FROM b_params p WHERE p.name IN ('hydrator','runtime_hydrator','runtime_refs') OR rx_matches(coalesce(p.ann,''),'\bHydrator\b') UNION SELECT __path,fn,name,CASE WHEN callback_kind='post_op_with_refs' AND position=2 THEN 'runtime_value' ELSE 'carrier' END FROM callback_parameters WHERE position=1 OR callback_kind='post_op_with_refs' AND position=2 UNION SELECT __path,fn,name,'carrier' FROM callback_parameters WHERE callback_kind='post_op_with_refs' AND position=2

stages.name: string_values
stages.query: SELECT __path,__start,__end,value FROM strings_in UNION SELECT i.__path,i.__start,i.__end,s.value FROM (SELECT __path,__start,__end,r2_l_kind AS l_kind,r2_target_text AS target_text,r2_v_kind AS v_kind,r2_v_start AS v_start,r2_v_end AS v_end,r2_inf AS inf,r2_mods AS mods,r2_top_start AS top_start,r2_top_end AS top_end FROM nodes_in WHERE r2_role IS NOT NULL) k JOIN strings_in s ON s.__path=k.__path AND s.__start=k.v_start AND s.__end=k.v_end JOIN b_idents i ON i.__path=k.__path AND i.text=k.target_text WHERE k.mods IS NOT NULL AND k.v_kind IN ('string','concatenated_string')

stages.name: special_attributes
stages.query: SELECT a.__path,a.fn,a.id AS node,'attribute' AS nkind,a.__start,a.__end,CASE WHEN a.objt='ctx' AND a.attr IN ('materialized_pipeline','sql_connection','txn') THEN 'context' ELSE 'carrier' END AS owner,a.attr FROM b_attrs a WHERE a.objt='ctx' AND a.attr IN ('materialized_pipeline','sql_connection','txn') OR a.attr IN ('_conn','_serverplan_runtime_txn','_serverplan_sql_conn','_txn','conn','connection','sql_conn','txn') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parameter_kinds p WHERE p.__path=a.__path AND p.fn=a.fn AND p.name=a.objt AND p.kind='carrier') UNION SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,'call',c.__start,c.__end,CASE WHEN c.a0t='ctx' THEN 'context' ELSE 'carrier' END,s.value FROM b_calls c JOIN string_values s ON s.__path=c.__path AND s.__start=c.a1_start AND s.__end=c.a1_end WHERE c.full_callee='getattr' AND c.a0_kind='identifier' AND (c.a0t='ctx' AND s.value IN ('materialized_pipeline','sql_connection','txn') OR s.value IN ('_conn','_serverplan_runtime_txn','_serverplan_sql_conn','_txn','conn','connection','sql_conn','txn') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parameter_kinds p WHERE p.__path=c.__path AND p.fn=c.fn AND p.name=c.a0t AND p.kind='carrier')) UNION SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,'call',c.__start,c.__end,'carrier',s.value FROM b_calls c JOIN string_values s ON s.__path=c.__path AND s.__start=c.a0_start AND s.__end=c.a0_end WHERE c.callee='get' AND c.callee_kind='attribute' AND s.value IN ('_conn','_serverplan_runtime_txn','_serverplan_sql_conn','_txn','conn','connection','sql_conn','txn') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parameter_kinds p WHERE p.__path=c.__path AND p.fn=c.fn AND p.name=c.recvt AND p.kind='carrier') UNION SELECT k.__path,k.fn,(k.__start*16777216+k.__end),'subscript',k.__start,k.__end,'carrier',s.value FROM b_subs k JOIN string_values s ON s.__path=k.__path AND s.__start=k.skey_start AND s.__end=k.skey_end WHERE k.v_kind='identifier' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parameter_kinds p WHERE p.__path=k.__path AND p.fn=k.fn AND p.name=k.vtext AND p.kind='carrier') UNION SELECT k.__path,k.fn,(k.ks_start*16777216+k.ks_end),'subscript',k.ks_start,k.ks_end,'carrier',s.value FROM b_idents k JOIN string_values s ON s.__path=k.__path AND s.__start=k.__start AND s.__end=k.__end WHERE k.ks_start IS NOT NULL AND s.value IN ('_conn','_serverplan_runtime_txn','_serverplan_sql_conn','_txn','conn','connection','sql_conn','txn') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parameter_kinds p WHERE p.__path=k.__path AND p.fn=k.fn AND p.name=k.kr AND p.kind='carrier')

query.template: WITH RECURSIVE runtime(__path,name) AS (SELECT DISTINCT c.__path,c.name FROM contexts c JOIN special_attributes a ON a.__path=c.__path AND a.fn=c.id AND a.owner='carrier' WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parameter_kinds p WHERE p.__path=c.__path AND p.fn=c.id AND p.kind='carrier') UNION SELECT DISTINCT c.__path,c.name FROM contexts c JOIN b_calls call ON call.__path=c.__path AND call.fn=c.id AND call.callee_kind='identifier' JOIN runtime r ON r.__path=call.__path AND r.name=call.callee WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM b_idents n JOIN parameter_kinds p ON p.__path=c.__path AND p.fn=c.id AND p.name=n.text AND p.kind='carrier' WHERE n.__path=call.__path AND n.__start>=call.args_start AND n.__end<=call.args_end AND NOT (n.__start=call.args_start AND n.__end=call.args_end) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM splats sp WHERE sp.__path=call.__path AND sp.call=call.id AND n.__start>=sp.__start AND n.__end<=sp.__end) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM b_kws k WHERE k.__path=call.__path AND k.call=call.id AND n.__start>=k.__start AND n.__end<=k.__end))) SELECT __path,name,'runtime_authority' AS kind FROM runtime UNION SELECT c.__path,c.name,'authority' FROM contexts c WHERE rx_matches(coalesce(c.rt,''),'\b(?:ReadTransaction|SyncDatabaseConnection|SyncSqlConnection|WriteTransaction)\b') UNION SELECT c.__path,c.name,'provider' FROM contexts c WHERE rx_matches(coalesce(c.rt,''),'\b(?:CrossBranchQueryProvider|HybridSearchProvider|VectorCandidateProvider|VersionedLoweringProvider|VersionedStorageProvider)\b') UNION SELECT DISTINCT c.__path,entry.key,kind.value FROM contexts c,json_each(CAST(X'{}' AS TEXT)) entry,json_each(entry.value) kind

stages.name: expression_edges
stages.query: SELECT __path,fn,id AS dst,__start,__end,object AS src FROM b_attrs UNION SELECT __path,fn,id,__start,__end,receiver FROM b_calls WHERE receiver IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT __path,fn,id,__start,__end,value FROM b_subs

stages.name: taints
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE taint(__path,fn,node,__start,__end,kind) AS (SELECT n.__path,n.fn,n.id,n.__start,n.__end,p.kind FROM b_idents n JOIN parameter_kinds p ON p.__path=n.__path AND p.fn=n.fn AND p.name=n.text WHERE p.kind!='carrier' UNION SELECT __path,fn,node,__start,__end,'authority' FROM special_attributes WHERE owner='carrier' OR attr IN ('txn','sql_connection') UNION SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,c.__start,c.__end,r.kind FROM b_calls c JOIN return_kinds r ON (r.__path=c.__path OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM project_mode)) AND r.name=c.callee UNION SELECT t.__path,t.fn,e.dst,e.__start,e.__end,t.kind FROM taint t JOIN expression_edges e ON e.__path=t.__path AND e.src=t.node AND e.fn=t.fn UNION SELECT t.__path,t.fn,n.id,n.__start,n.__end,t.kind FROM taint t JOIN b_assigns a ON a.__path=t.__path AND a.value=t.node AND a.fn=t.fn JOIN b_idents n ON n.__path=a.__path AND n.fn=t.fn AND n.text=a.target_text WHERE a.target_kind='identifier' AND t.kind IN ('authority','provider','runtime_value')) SELECT * FROM taint

stages.name: semantic_seeds
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE semantic(__path,fn,node,__start,__end) AS (SELECT __path,fn,node,__start,__end FROM taints WHERE kind='runtime_value' UNION SELECT n.__path,n.fn,n.id,n.__start,n.__end FROM b_idents n JOIN parameter_kinds p ON p.__path=n.__path AND p.fn=n.fn AND p.name=n.text AND p.kind='carrier' UNION SELECT n.__path,n.fn,n.id,n.__start,n.__end FROM semantic s JOIN b_assigns a ON a.__path=s.__path AND a.fn=s.fn AND a.v_start<=s.__start AND a.v_end>=s.__end AND (a.v_kind NOT IN ('argument_list','block','decorated_definition','expression_statement','module','type') OR a.value=s.node) JOIN b_idents n ON n.__path=a.__path AND n.fn=a.fn AND n.text=a.target_text WHERE a.target_kind='identifier') SELECT * FROM semantic

stages.name: direct_events
stages.query: SELECT n.__path,n.fn,n.id AS node,'eager_sql' AS kind,1 AS priority,n.__start AS __start,n.__end AS __end FROM b_calls n WHERE n.callee IN ('execute_grammar_fetchall_direct','execute_grammar_fetchall_direct_async','execute_grammar_fetchall_with_params_direct','execute_grammar_fetchall_with_params_direct_async','execute_grammar_fetchone_direct','execute_grammar_fetchone_direct_async','execute_grammar_fetchone_with_params_direct','execute_grammar_fetchone_with_params_direct_async','grammar_effect_lazy','grammar_execute','grammar_execute_async','grammar_fetchall','grammar_fetchall_async','grammar_fetchone','grammar_fetchone_async','grammar_row_lazy','grammar_rows_lazy','grammar_scalar','grammar_scalar_async','grammar_value_lazy') OR n.callee_kind='identifier' AND n.callee IN ('execute','execute_async','execute_ddl','execute_ddl_async','executemany','executemany_async','fetchall','fetchall_async','fetchone','fetchone_async','scalar','scalar_async') OR n.full IS NOT NULL AND rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)(?:conn(?:\([^)]*\))?\.execute|conn(?:\([^)]*\))?\.execute_async|conn(?:\([^)]*\))?\.fetchall|conn(?:\([^)]*\))?\.fetchall_async|conn(?:\([^)]*\))?\.fetchone|conn(?:\([^)]*\))?\.fetchone_async|connection(?:\([^)]*\))?\.execute|connection(?:\([^)]*\))?\.execute_async|connection(?:\([^)]*\))?\.fetchall|connection(?:\([^)]*\))?\.fetchall_async|connection(?:\([^)]*\))?\.fetchone|connection(?:\([^)]*\))?\.fetchone_async|cursor(?:\([^)]*\))?\.execute|cursor(?:\([^)]*\))?\.executemany|query(?:\([^)]*\))?\.execute|query(?:\([^)]*\))?\.execute_async|query(?:\([^)]*\))?\.fetchall|query(?:\([^)]*\))?\.fetchall_async|query(?:\([^)]*\))?\.fetchone|query(?:\([^)]*\))?\.fetchone_async|txn(?:\([^)]*\))?\.execute|txn(?:\([^)]*\))?\.execute_async|txn(?:\([^)]*\))?\.fetchall|txn(?:\([^)]*\))?\.fetchall_async|txn(?:\([^)]*\))?\.fetchone|txn(?:\([^)]*\))?\.fetchone_async)$') UNION SELECT n.__path,n.fn,n.id AS node,'eager_sql' AS kind,1 AS priority,n.__start AS __start,n.__end AS __end FROM taints t  JOIN b_calls n ON n.__path=t.__path AND n.fn=t.fn AND n.receiver=t.node WHERE t.kind='authority' AND n.callee IN ('execute','execute_async','execute_ddl','execute_ddl_async','executemany','executemany_async','fetchall','fetchall_async','fetchone','fetchone_async','scalar','scalar_async') UNION SELECT n.__path,n.fn,n.id AS node,'native_python_work' AS kind,1 AS priority,n.__start AS __start,n.__end AS __end FROM b_calls n WHERE n.callee IN ('create_usearch_index_class','deserialize_embedding','get_similarity_function','serialize_embedding') OR n.full IS NOT NULL AND rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)(?:np(?:\([^)]*\))?\.array|np(?:\([^)]*\))?\.ascontiguousarray|np(?:\([^)]*\))?\.isinf|np(?:\([^)]*\))?\.isnan|numpy(?:\([^)]*\))?\.array|numpy(?:\([^)]*\))?\.ascontiguousarray|numpy(?:\([^)]*\))?\.isinf|numpy(?:\([^)]*\))?\.isnan)$') UNION SELECT n.__path,n.fn,n.id AS node,'runtime_callback' AS kind,1 AS priority,n.__start AS __start,n.__end AS __end FROM b_calls n WHERE n.callee='CompiledStep' AND n.refs UNION SELECT n.__path,n.fn,n.id AS node,'large_column' AS kind,1 AS priority,n.__start AS __start,n.__end AS __end FROM b_calls n WHERE n.callee IN ('explicit_plan_execution_scope','hydrate_many_post_op','hydrate_one_post_op','runtime_sql_conn_from_hydrator') OR n.callee='convert_row_to_model' AND n.hyd UNION SELECT n.__path,n.fn,n.id AS node,'resolved_refs' AS kind,1 AS priority,n.__start AS __start,n.__end AS __end FROM b_calls n WHERE n.callee IN ('get','peek','resolve_server_ref') AND n.res UNION SELECT n.__path,n.fn,n.id AS node,'nested_execute' AS kind,1 AS priority,n.__start AS __start,n.__end AS __end FROM b_calls n WHERE n.callee IN ('execute_runtime_nested_steps_async','execute_runtime_nested_steps_sync') OR n.full IS NOT NULL AND rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)(?:PlanExecutor(?:\([^)]*\))?\.execute|PlanExecutor(?:\([^)]*\))?\.execute_async|executor(?:\([^)]*\))?\.execute|executor(?:\([^)]*\))?\.execute_async)$') UNION SELECT n.__path,n.fn,n.id AS node,'materialized_pipeline' AS kind,1 AS priority,n.__start AS __start,n.__end AS __end FROM b_attrs n WHERE n.attr='materialized_pipeline' UNION SELECT n.__path,n.fn,n.node AS node,'materialized_pipeline' AS kind,1 AS priority,n.__start AS __start,n.__end AS __end FROM special_attributes n WHERE n.attr='materialized_pipeline' AND n.owner='context' UNION SELECT n.__path,n.fn,n.node AS node,'ctx_access' AS kind,1 AS priority,n.__start AS __start,n.__end AS __end FROM special_attributes n WHERE n.owner='context' UNION SELECT n.__path,n.fn,n.node AS node,'runtime_authority' AS kind,1 AS priority,n.__start AS __start,n.__end AS __end FROM special_attributes n WHERE n.owner='carrier' AND n.nkind IN ('attribute','call') UNION SELECT n.__path,n.fn,n.id AS node,'runtime_authority' AS kind,1 AS priority,n.__start AS __start,n.__end AS __end FROM b_calls n WHERE n.callee IN ('active_pipeline_txn_for_callbacks') UNION SELECT n.__path,n.fn,n.id AS node,'runtime_authority' AS kind,1 AS priority,n.__start AS __start,n.__end AS __end FROM taints t  JOIN b_calls n ON n.__path=t.__path AND n.fn=t.fn AND n.id=t.node WHERE t.kind='runtime_authority' AND 1 UNION SELECT n.__path,n.fn,n.id AS node,'runtime_authority' AS kind,0 AS priority,n.__start AS __start,n.__end AS __end FROM taints t  JOIN b_assigns n ON n.__path=t.__path AND n.fn=t.fn AND n.value=t.node WHERE t.kind='runtime_authority' AND 1 UNION SELECT n.__path,n.fn,n.id AS node,'runtime_value' AS kind,0 AS priority,n.__start AS __start,n.__end AS __end FROM taints t  JOIN b_assigns n ON n.__path=t.__path AND n.fn=t.fn AND n.value=t.node WHERE t.kind='runtime_value' AND 1 UNION SELECT n.__path,n.fn,n.id AS node,'runtime_value' AS kind,1 AS priority,n.__start AS __start,n.__end AS __end FROM taints t  JOIN b_calls n ON n.__path=t.__path AND n.fn=t.fn AND n.id=t.node WHERE t.kind='runtime_value' AND 1 UNION SELECT n.__path,n.fn,n.id AS node,'runtime_value' AS kind,1 AS priority,n.__start AS __start,n.__end AS __end FROM taints t  JOIN b_calls n ON n.__path=t.__path AND n.fn=t.fn AND n.receiver=t.node WHERE t.kind='runtime_value' AND 1 UNION SELECT n.__path,n.fn,n.id AS node,'runtime_value' AS kind,1 AS priority,n.__start AS __start,n.__end AS __end FROM taints t JOIN b_args a ON a.__path=t.__path AND a.id=t.node JOIN b_calls n ON n.__path=t.__path AND n.fn=t.fn AND n.id=a.call WHERE t.kind='runtime_value' AND 1 UNION SELECT n.__path,n.fn,n.id AS node,'runtime_value' AS kind,1 AS priority,n.__start AS __start,n.__end AS __end FROM taints t JOIN b_kws k ON k.__path=t.__path AND k.value=t.node JOIN b_calls n ON n.__path=t.__path AND n.fn=t.fn AND n.id=k.call WHERE t.kind='runtime_value' AND 1 UNION SELECT n.__path,n.fn,n.id AS node,'runtime_value' AS kind,1 AS priority,n.__start AS __start,n.__end AS __end FROM taints t  JOIN b_subs n ON n.__path=t.__path AND n.fn=t.fn AND n.value=t.node WHERE t.kind='runtime_value' AND n.v_kind='identifier' UNION SELECT n.__path,n.fn,(n.cmp_start*16777216+n.cmp_end) AS node,'runtime_value' AS kind,1 AS priority,n.cmp_start AS __start,n.cmp_end AS __end FROM taints t  JOIN b_idents n ON n.__path=t.__path AND n.fn=t.fn AND n.id=t.node WHERE t.kind='runtime_value' AND n.cmp_start IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT n.__path,n.fn,n.id AS node,'provider_authority' AS kind,1 AS priority,n.__start AS __start,n.__end AS __end FROM taints t  JOIN b_calls n ON n.__path=t.__path AND n.fn=t.fn AND n.receiver=t.node WHERE t.kind='provider' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM b_args a JOIN taints t ON t.__path=a.__path AND t.fn=n.fn AND t.node=a.id AND t.kind='authority' WHERE a.__path=n.__path AND a.call=n.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM b_kws k JOIN taints t ON t.__path=k.__path AND t.fn=n.fn AND t.node=k.value AND t.kind='authority' WHERE k.__path=n.__path AND k.call=n.id)) UNION SELECT n.__path,n.fn,n.id AS node,'runtime_semantic_projection' AS kind,1 AS priority,n.__start AS __start,n.__end AS __end FROM b_calls n WHERE n.callee IN ('all','any','filter','len','map','max','min','reversed','sorted','sum') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM semantic_seeds v WHERE v.__path=n.__path AND v.fn=n.fn AND v.__start>=n.args_start AND v.__end<=n.args_end AND NOT (v.__start=n.args_start AND v.__end=n.args_end) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM splats sp WHERE sp.__path=n.__path AND sp.call=n.id AND v.__start>=sp.__start AND v.__end<=sp.__end) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM b_idents w WHERE w.__path=v.__path AND w.id=v.node AND w.kwn IS NOT NULL)) OR n.callee IN ('count','index','reverse','sort') AND n.receiver IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM semantic_seeds v WHERE v.__path=n.__path AND v.fn=n.fn AND v.__start>=n.recv_start AND v.__end<=n.recv_end AND (n.recv_kind NOT IN ('argument_list','block','decorated_definition','expression_statement','module','type') OR v.node=n.receiver)) UNION SELECT n.__path,n.fn,n.id AS node,'runtime_semantic_projection' AS kind,1 AS priority,n.__start AS __start,n.__end AS __end FROM b_subs n WHERE n.slice AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM semantic_seeds v WHERE v.__path=n.__path AND v.fn=n.fn AND v.__start>=n.v_start AND v.__end<=n.v_end AND (n.v_kind NOT IN ('argument_list','block','decorated_definition','expression_statement','module','type') OR v.node=n.value)) UNION SELECT n.__path,n.fn,(n.comp_start*16777216+n.comp_end) AS node,'runtime_semantic_projection' AS kind,1 AS priority,n.comp_start AS __start,n.comp_end AS __end FROM (SELECT *,(c.top_start*16777216+c.top_end) AS fn FROM (SELECT __path,__start,__end,r9_r_kind AS r_kind,r9_r_start AS r_start,r9_r_end AS r_end,r9_comp_kind AS comp_kind,r9_comp_start AS comp_start,r9_comp_end AS comp_end,r9_top_start AS top_start,r9_top_end AS top_end FROM nodes_in WHERE r9_role IS NOT NULL) c) n WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM semantic_seeds v WHERE v.__path=n.__path AND v.fn=n.fn AND v.__start>=n.r_start AND v.__end<=n.r_end AND (n.r_kind NOT IN ('argument_list','block','decorated_definition','expression_statement','module','type') OR v.node=(n.r_start*16777216+n.r_end))) UNION SELECT n.__path,n.fn,(n.__start*16777216+n.__end) AS node,'runtime_semantic_projection' AS kind,1 AS priority,n.__start AS __start,n.__end AS __end FROM (SELECT *,(l.top_start*16777216+l.top_end) AS fn FROM (SELECT __path,__start,__end,r10_r_kind AS r_kind,r10_r_start AS r_start,r10_r_end AS r_end,r10_l_start AS l_start,r10_l_end AS l_end,r10_top_start AS top_start,r10_top_end AS top_end FROM nodes_in WHERE r10_role IS NOT NULL) l) n WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM semantic_seeds v WHERE v.__path=n.__path AND v.fn=n.fn AND v.__start>=n.r_start AND v.__end<=n.r_end AND (n.r_kind NOT IN ('argument_list','block','decorated_definition','expression_statement','module','type') OR v.node=(n.r_start*16777216+n.r_end))) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM b_calls c WHERE c.__path=n.__path AND c.__start>=n.__start AND c.__end<=n.__end AND c.callee IN ('append','extend')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT __path,__start,__end FROM b_subs UNION ALL SELECT __path,__start,__end FROM b_calls WHERE callee IN ('get','getattr')) pr WHERE pr.__path=n.__path AND pr.__start>=n.__start AND pr.__end<=n.__end AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM b_idents u JOIN b_idents t ON t.__path=u.__path AND t.text=u.text AND t.__start>=n.l_start AND t.__end<=n.l_end WHERE u.__path=pr.__path AND u.__start>=pr.__start AND u.__end<=pr.__end)) UNION SELECT n.__path,n.fn,(n.__start*16777216+n.__end) AS node,'runtime_sequence_projection' AS kind,1 AS priority,n.__start AS __start,n.__end AS __end FROM (SELECT *,(l.top_start*16777216+l.top_end) AS fn FROM (SELECT __path,__start,__end,r10_r_kind AS r_kind,r10_r_start AS r_start,r10_r_end AS r_end,r10_l_start AS l_start,r10_l_end AS l_end,r10_top_start AS top_start,r10_top_end AS top_end FROM nodes_in WHERE r10_role IS NOT NULL) l) n WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM semantic_seeds v WHERE v.__path=n.__path AND v.fn=n.fn AND v.__start>=n.r_start AND v.__end<=n.r_end AND (n.r_kind NOT IN ('argument_list','block','decorated_definition','expression_statement','module','type') OR v.node=(n.r_start*16777216+n.r_end))) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM b_calls c WHERE c.__path=n.__path AND c.__start>=n.__start AND c.__end<=n.__end AND c.callee IN ('append','extend')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT __path,__start,__end FROM b_subs UNION ALL SELECT __path,__start,__end FROM b_calls WHERE callee IN ('get','getattr')) pr WHERE pr.__path=n.__path AND pr.__start>=n.__start AND pr.__end<=n.__end AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM b_idents u JOIN b_idents t ON t.__path=u.__path AND
